title: CERC Adopts Rs 3.64-3.65/kWh Tariff for SJVN's 600 MW ISTS-Connected Wind Projects
case_name: In the matter of adoption of tariff for 600 MW ISTS-connected wind power projects set up by SJVN Limited under competitive bidding
card_summary: CERC adopted the tariffs discovered in SJVN's reverse e-auction for 600 MW of ISTS-connected wind capacity, awarding Rs 3.64/kWh to Urdhvaga, Adyant and KPI Green Energy and Rs 3.65/kWh to Lambent. SJVN floated the tender in September 2025 and held the auction in February 2026. The Commission called the rates comparable to other wind tenders of the period and directed SJVN to sign the purchase and sale agreements.
card_tip: Developers awarded capacity in this tranche can now execute PPAs and PSAs. Cite the order by petition number, not tranche name, since several SJVN 600 MW wind tranches carry similar headlines but different tariffs.
verification_notes: Cross-verified via two independent trade-press reports (Mercom India and SolarQuarter), both dated 15 October 2026 and both citing Petition No. 234/AT/2026 and the same capacity split (Urdhvaga 120 MW, Adyant 110 MW, KPI Green Energy 300 MW, Lambent 70 MW) and tariffs. Distinguished from other similarly named SJVN 600 MW wind tranches reported with different figures (e.g. Rs 3.98-3.99/kWh and Rs 3.74/Rs 3.81/kWh tranches from earlier petitions in 2025-26) by petition number and tariff figures; CERC's record of proceedings for Petition 234/AT/2026 (cercind.gov.in) confirms the petition number and SJVN as petitioner.
